SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           > SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'female'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           < SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'male'
        ELSE 'tie'
    END AS group_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           > SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           - SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           < SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           - SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'B') AS finished_not_paid,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'C') AS running_ok,

    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN loan_status = 'charged off' THEN approved_amount END), 2) AS avg_not_paid,
    ROUND(
        AVG(CASE WHEN loan_status = 'fully paid' THEN approved_amount END) -
        AVG(CASE WHEN loan_status = 'charged off' THEN approved_amount END), 2
    ) AS difference

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN card_type = 'Classic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN card_type = 'Gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_transactions
FROM transactions;

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cash_withdrawn_usd
FROM transactions
WHERE type = 'withdrawal'
  AND method = 'cash';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS average_withdrawal_usd
FROM credit_card_withdrawals;

SELECT
    cash_total,
    credit_card_total,
    CASE
        WHEN cash_total > credit_card_total THEN 'Cash withdrawals'
        WHEN credit_card_total > cash_total THEN 'Credit-card withdrawals'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS larger_category,
    ABS(cash_total - credit_card_total) AS difference_usd
FROM (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_usd), 0) FROM cash_withdrawals)          AS cash_total,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_usd), 0) FROM credit_card_withdrawals)   AS credit_card_total
) t;

SELECT SUM(amount) AS gross_dollars
FROM transactions
WHERE transaction_date >= '1998-12-01'

SELECT MAX(balance) AS highest_balance

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'loan_repayment') / COUNT(*) AS percentage

FROM loans
